name: Requirement-linked verification evidence and test results
systemOfRecord: The contract-designated original test/inspection report and supporting evidence under DI-NDTI-80809B, when invoked.
The contract-designated native relational RTVM database under DI-MGMT-82133A, when invoked.
The contract-designated Software Test Report under DI-IPSC-81440A for the separately invoked software-testing scope.

formats.format: Contractor-selected test/inspection report presentation; selected JSON receiving representation
formats.spec: DI-NDTI-80809B, 10.1 permits contractor format. Complete contractual report content/presentation still follows 10.2–10.2.8 as applicable. JSON is a selection for this receiving contract, not a government native schema. The sample is only a partial evidence excerpt.

formats.format: Electronic relational database plus required package content
formats.spec: DI-MGMT-82133A, section 2 and 3. Native manipulable database supports bidirectional requirements traceability and verification tracking. No standalone CSV/JSON substitution is granted. The deterministic snapshot is for hashing and does not replace the native deliverable.

formats.format: Contractor format unless otherwise specified on the CDRL; paper or permitted alternative-form presentation
formats.spec: DI-IPSC-81440A, sections 2–4, only when separately invoked for CSCI/software-system qualification or other contract-identified software-related testing. Alternative-form identity, access/contents and tailoring duties remain. No universal extension, database vendor or encoding is imposed.

cadence: No fixed submission interval or event-plus-days deadline appears in the three inspected DIDs. Use the actual contract/CDRL delivery schedule and applicable document issues; do not infer monthly, real-time, or automatic newest-edition requirements. Report/test dates and chronological software-test logs are content, not a delivery cadence. The eight open policy/source gaps prevent a claim of comprehensive policy timing coverage.

fields.name: profile
fields.description: Receiving-contract discriminator: exactly one of DI-NDTI-80809B, DI-MGMT-82133A, or DI-IPSC-81440A per payload. This field name is a user-selected transport choice, not a native DID field. Each profile applies only when actually invoked; the optional software profile is not imposed on other reports.

fields.name: completeness
fields.description: Receiving-contract label: complete-delivery or partial-example. A partial-example is retained only for demonstration and cannot be accepted as a complete contractual report or native relational database.

fields.name: report
fields.description: Report/package context, conditionally required for complete delivery of the selected profile. Contains actual invocation, contract/CDRL issue selection and applicability/tailoring decisions in report.invocation, plus the relevant testInspectionReport, rtvm, or softwareTestReport content groups below. Source content retains its native presentation as delivered. The sample contains only a non-operative sampleNotice; no contract invocation is fabricated.

fields.name: evidence
fields.description: User-selected requirement-linked evidence records. Three rows occur only in sample. The row fields below are a receiving-feed representation of actual source content, not a universal native government schema. Complete deliveries include all applicable records, not merely the sample columns.

fields.name: nativeDelivery
fields.description: Conditionally required to preserve the actual native relational-database package for the RTVM and any full report/evidence attachments not completely represented in the semantic payload. Each received file has unique attachmentId, fileName, mediaType, role (relationalDatabase or operativeAttachment), and complete unaltered contentBase64. Base64 is an in-payload preservation choice, not a substitute for the accessible, manipulable relational database required by DZR-F8-0024. A URI or digest alone is not evidence content. Guidance-library documents are catalogued separately, not included as operative attachments. The five listed member names are exhaustive for each nativeDelivery entry: attachmentId, fileName, mediaType, role, contentBase64. Extra raw-file digest, byte-size, modified-time or other metadata fields are rejected by this receiving contract, so a guidance-only native-database change cannot enter the operative digest through derived file metadata.

fields.name: evidenceId
fields.description: Receiving-feed primary identity for an evidence row; unique and nonempty after normalization. Source DIDs do not prescribe this name or syntax. A source test identifier, database record identity, and this receiving identity remain distinguishable.

fields.name: wbsId
fields.description: User-required explicit WBS join for each evidence row. Missing, blank, ambiguous, or unresolved joins reject production acceptance. This is a receiving-feed rule, not a WBS-key mandate attributed to these DIDs.

fields.name: requirementId
fields.description: User-required explicit requirement join for each evidence row. Missing, blank, ambiguous, or unresolved joins reject production acceptance. Map to the actual source requirement identity; the chosen field name and syntax are not imposed by the DIDs.

fields.name: requirementText
fields.description: Receiving-feed preservation of the actual applicable requirement statement alongside its join identity. This user-selected context prevents a baseline that contains only mutable external identifiers. Sample wording is fictional and confined to the three sample rows.

fields.name: method
fields.description: Conditionally carries the actual procedure/method designation. For RTVM, use exactly Analysis, Demonstration, Inspection, or Test with the meanings in DI-MGMT-82133A section 3.2.19. The method-field definitions there literally attribute MIL-STD-961E with Change 2; no newer edition is silently substituted. The general test report does not impose that closed machine enum.

fields.name: criteria
fields.description: Applicable test parameters, performance requirements, acceptance/compliance limits and environmental criteria, correlated to contractual requirements. Values, units and context are preserved. This selected object is not a universal scoring or pass/fail formula.

fields.name: recordedData
fields.description: Actual recorded results, with units, conditions and data context. Extensive recorded data belongs in an appendix in the complete source report; complete content still enters the canonical evidence payload or an operative attachment. The partial sample is not a claim of full experimental evidence.

fields.name: resultDiscussion
fields.description: Achieved-result comparison to objectives/requirements, significance, applicable prior-test comparisons and calculation examples, anomalies/deviations/discrepancies/failures with impacts, causes, proposed corrective actions and design-versus-tested-configuration discrepancies. Complete source scope is retained in the report result group even when a small row excerpt is shown.

fields.name: result
fields.description: For the general test report, preserves the stated recommendation/acceptability outcome where applicable; pass or fail is not the same as authentication or all evidence completeness. A failing result can be valid report data. The sample row result is only an illustrative outcome, not a signed certification. Do not map this field onto the RTVM requirement-status, OEM-compliance or Yes/No conformity enums.

fields.name: report.testInspectionReport.coverAndTitle
fields.description: Conditional on actual invocation of DI-NDTI-80809B and the source qualifications retained in the acceptance rules. This is a grouped logical content mapping, not prescribed native column names. Source content items: reportDate, reportNumber, contractorName, contractorAddress, cageCode, contractNumber, contractLineItemOrSequenceNumber, testInspectionType, itemIdentification, testInspectionDateOrPeriod, requiringGovernmentActivityName, requiringGovernmentActivityAddress, securityClassification, downgradingInformation, declassifyingInformation. The applicable identification appears on both outside front cover and title page; contractor/Government report number and contract line item/sequence alternatives remain as stated.

fields.name: report.testInspectionReport.acceptabilityCertification

fields.name: report.testInspectionReport.appendices

Source content items: appendixDocumentation, referencedDocumentationNotGovernmentProvided, associatedActivityTestInspectionReports. fields.description: Conditional on actual invocation of DI-MGMT-82133A and the source qualifications retained in the acceptance rules. This is a grouped logical content mapping, not prescribed native column names. Source content items: applicableSourceIssues. No automatic replacement by a newly published issue; use contract-specified issue selection.

fields.name: report.rtvm.coverAndChanges

fields.name: report.rtvm.architecture
fields.description: Conditional on actual invocation of DI-MGMT-82133A and the source qualifications retained in the acceptance rules. This is a grouped logical content mapping, not prescribed native column names. Source content items: databaseArchitecture, relationships, fieldDefinitions. Detailed database architecture, relationships and field term/acronym definitions accompany the native data.

fields.name: report.rtvm.tierHierarchy
fields.description: Conditional on actual invocation of DI-MGMT-82133A and the source qualifications retained in the acceptance rules. This is a grouped logical content mapping, not prescribed native column names. Source content items: tier0Uid, tier1Uid, tier2Uid, tier3Uid, tier0RequirementText, tier1RequirementText, tier2RequirementText, tier3RequirementText. Preserve Tier 0 and Tier 1 UIDs/text and required Tier 2/3 UIDs/text with actual parent/derivation relations. Tier 2/3 are conditional. No UID pattern is inferred from source examples.

fields.name: report.rtvm.requirementSource
fields.description: Conditional on actual invocation of DI-MGMT-82133A and the source qualifications retained in the acceptance rules. This is a grouped logical content mapping, not prescribed native column names. Source content items: sourceDocumentNumber, sourceDocumentTitle, sourceParagraph. Source document number/title and exact source paragraph remain with each requirement statement.

fields.name: report.rtvm.requirementType
fields.description: Conditional on actual invocation of DI-MGMT-82133A and the source qualifications retained in the acceptance rules. This is a grouped logical content mapping, not prescribed native column names. Source content items: requirementType. Closed source values: Derived or Decomposed.

fields.name: report.rtvm.requirementAttribute
fields.description: Conditional on actual invocation of DI-MGMT-82133A and the source qualifications retained in the acceptance rules. This is a grouped logical content mapping, not prescribed native column names. Source content items: requirementAttribute. Named performance, design, software-functional, interface, physical, environmental and cybersecurity categories are extensible when needed; do not reject legitimate other attributes.

fields.name: report.rtvm.oemCompliance
fields.description: Conditional on actual invocation of DI-MGMT-82133A and the source qualifications retained in the acceptance rules. This is a grouped logical content mapping, not prescribed native column names. Source content items: oemCompliance. Closed source values: Compliant, Non-Compliant, Partial Compliant. Not equivalent to approval status or a Yes/No conformity response.

fields.name: report.rtvm.requirementStatus

This is a grouped logical content mapping, not prescribed native column names. Source content items: requirementStatus. Closed source values: Approved, Under Review, Needs Revision, Rejected. The separate should recommendation to identify latest revision number is guidance only and excluded from the operative projection.

fields.name: report.rtvm.nonConformanceReferences

fields.name: report.rtvm.designAndAllocation

fields.name: report.rtvm.verificationResults

This is a grouped logical content mapping, not prescribed native column names. Source content items: verificationResults, conformityResult. Preserve the complete verification result and conformity Yes or No. A No result is valid report content, not an automatic data-delivery rejection.

fields.name: report.rtvm.correctiveActionsAndComments
fields.description: Conditional on actual invocation of DI-MGMT-82133A and the source qualifications retained in the acceptance rules. This is a grouped logical content mapping, not prescribed native column names. Source content items: correctiveActions, correctiveActionResults, comments. Record actions actually taken and their results; comments as required. No corrective-action execution duty is inferred.

fields.name: report.rtvm.databaseSnapshot
fields.description: Required receiving-contract baseline representation when the RTVM profile is delivered: a complete, reconciled semantic snapshot of the actual relational database, including every native table/column definition, primary/foreign keys, every record and value, and relationships; associated cover/change/architecture/term content and operative evidence remain included. Tables are represented by tableName, columns, primaryKey, foreignKeys, rows; table rows are complete objects keyed by native column names. This snapshot supports deterministic hashing but is not itself the mandated native database. Raw native delivery is preserved separately and reconciled against it. No requirement-only ID list, selected-column summary, or pointer-only snapshot is complete.

fields.name: report.rtvm.guidanceColumnMap
fields.description: Receiving-contract provenance identifying only native columns devoted exclusively to the nonbinding latest requirement-status revision-number recommendation in section 3.2.14. Each entry identifies tableName and columnName. Their column definitions and row values are omitted from the operative baseline projection; the original native delivery is preserved. A column also serving any operative obligation, primary/foreign key or relationship is not guidance-only and cannot be removed. This map itself is excluded from the baseline. Other handbook/guide catalogue content stays outside the selected payload. Parallel copies of the guidance-only latest-status revision value in other operative JSON groups are not permitted; preserve any such guidance only in the original native database and the separate guidance catalogue. This excludes semantic copies of the recommendation, not identical scalar values serving an independent operative obligation.

markings: Retain source-required and actual contract-directed report/database classification, distribution, export-control and handling identification in the applicable profile; DZR-F8-0001, DZR-F8-0025 and DZR-F8-0050 are conditional. Public-release status of the DIDs does not establish the classification or release status of delivered test data. DoDI 5230.24, DoDI 5200.48 and DoDM 5200.01 Volume 2 remain uninspected open gaps; no missing marking rules are inferred. The three sample rows are fictional illustrations and do not carry fabricated classification assertions, contract identifiers or signatures.

acceptance.rule: Receiving-contract rule, not a source-derived schema: parse one well-formed JSON object with exactly profile, completeness, report, evidence and nativeDelivery as the only permitted top-level names. profile, completeness and evidence are required; report/nativeDelivery are conditional as described. Reject unknown root keys, duplicate object keys before or after normalization, invalid Unicode scalar strings, non-finite numeric values, or malformed Base64.

Receiving-contract rule: reject missing/blank/duplicate normalized evidenceId and missing, ambiguous or unresolved wbsId or requirementId on any evidence row. Resolve both joins against the actual controlled WBS and requirement records; do not silently create target records. Preserve actual requirementText and all operative context/evidence. Synthetic sample identities do not establish production join resolution.

Receiving-contract applicability rule: for complete-delivery, identify actual contract/CDRL invocation and issue selection, select the appropriate DID profile, and document applicable content/certification/tailoring decisions. Missing applicability evidence does not authorize assuming that all three profiles bind. Do not accept a partial-example as a complete-delivery.

Receiving-contract production acceptance requires the actual contractor-selected presentation to be acceptable under the governing contract/CDRL and all applicable source report/package content, cover/title identity, layout/index/access structure, certifications and evidence to be delivered. A JSON evidence-row excerpt, even with valid hashes and resolved joins, is not proof of full report-format compliance or an accepted contractual baseline. A digest may be computed for a rejected or partial payload, but that digest does not change its acceptance status.

The sample is an unauthenticated partial DI-NDTI-80809B evidence excerpt. It lacks a complete cover/title page, contents, report sections, certifications/signatures and applicable appendices, and no external WBS/requirement targets were supplied. Retain for demonstration only; it cannot pass production full-report or join acceptance. Its hash demonstrates content integrity, not compliance, authentication or approval.

canonicalForm:
The selected receiving payload is a JSON object with only profile, completeness, report, evidence and nativeDelivery as root keys. Hash the complete operative projection of this payload; this is a delivered-data baseline, not a hash of the requirement catalogue, IDs alone, a schema, or this C document. In the displayed partial DI-NDTI-80809B sample the projection is the entire parsed sample object, with no omitted field or evidence row. The displayed baselineHash is for that sample only, not a real delivery or the 71-record requirement catalogue. Production drops compute a new baseline from their complete actual payload and applicable context.

If any operative content is not fully represented as semantic JSON, retain it in nativeDelivery.contentBase64; filenames, URLs and digests alone are insufficient. Source DIDs do not prescribe this selected serialization.
For DI-MGMT-82133A, first preserve the complete actual accessible native relational-database delivery. Reconcile report.rtvm.databaseSnapshot to every actual native table, column definition/type, record identity and value, primary/foreign key and relationship, with cover, change history, architecture/term descriptions and operative verification evidence also present. The snapshot's tables array contains tableName, columns, primaryKey, foreignKeys and rows, with each row containing all native columns. There is no sampled-record or selected-operative-column projection. Only columns mapped by report.rtvm.guidanceColumnMap exclusively to the nonbinding latest requirement-status revision-number recommendation are omitted from table column definitions and from every row; omit guidanceColumnMap itself from the hash. A key, relationship, cover revision date, operative or dual-purpose column cannot be excluded. Original database bytes remain retained unchanged but, for nativeDelivery entries with role relationalDatabase, omit contentBase64 from the canonical projection so guidance-only values in the physical file do not enter the operative baseline. Only attachmentId, fileName, mediaType and role remain for these entries, while the complete reconciled operative snapshot supplies the content. Each nativeDelivery entry has exactly these four fields plus contentBase64 before projection; reject added raw-file hashes, byte sizes, timestamps or other metadata so excluded guidance values cannot leak through derived file metadata. Reject parallel semantic copies of guide-only latest-status revision values elsewhere in operative JSON, including report.rtvm.requirementStatus; preserve independently operative cover revision dates and dual-purpose values. These are selected receiving-contract projection rules, not additional DID obligations. Other operative attachments remain fully included. The receiving projection never substitutes for required native-database delivery. Handbook/guide library documents and guidance catalogue fields stay outside the payload and hash.
Canonical parsing rejects duplicate JSON member names, non-finite numbers, invalid Unicode scalar sequences and normalization collisions. Apply Unicode NFC to every object key and string value, then trim leading/trailing Unicode White_Space and collapse each internal run to one U+0020. White_Space is U+0009–000D, U+0020, U+0085, U+00A0, U+1680, U+2000–200A, U+2028–2029, U+202F, U+205F, U+3000. Boolean and null remain JSON true/false/null. Parse numeric tokens as exact base-10 values, not binary floating-point; emit finite numbers without exponent, leading plus, redundant leading zeros or fractional trailing zeros; emit every signed zero as 0. Preserve decimal value exactly.
Sort object keys by Unicode scalar code-point order after normalization. Sort evidence records by normalized evidenceId in that same order; duplicate evidenceId rejects. Sort nativeDelivery entries by normalized attachmentId; duplicates reject. For RTVM, sort databaseSnapshot.tables by normalized tableName; duplicates reject, and sort each table's rows by its complete canonical serialized row text in code-point order, preserving the multiplicity of identical rows. Do not sort chronological logs, source-ordered steps, change histories, key-column lists, or any other arrays: preserve their supplied semantic order. Canonicalize row objects before comparing row texts. Schema/relationship definitions and all non-guidance record data remain in the projection.
Serialize compact JSON with no whitespace outside strings. Emit quote as backslash-quote, backslash as two backslashes, remaining U+0000–001F control characters as lowercase four-digit Unicode escapes, and all other Unicode scalar characters literally; do not escape forward slash or non-ASCII text. Encode the resulting JSON as UTF-8 without BOM, after the task-wide final NFC/trim/Unicode-whitespace-collapse normalization. Compute SHA-256 and express 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits.
